description:
Discover the heart of Tokyo in this immersive 4K walking tour through one of the world’s most dynamic cities. From the neon-lit streets of Shinjuku to the iconic energy of Shibuya, this walk takes you through bustling districts, hidden alleyways, and some of Tokyo’s most recognizable landmarks. Along the way, you’ll experience the contrast that defines the city, vibrant entertainment areas, quiet side streets, and unique cultural moments around every corner, especially its famous nightlife.

From the neon-lit streets of Shinjuku to the iconic energy of Shibuya, this walk takes you through bustling districts, hidden alleyways, and some of Tokyo’s most recognizable landmarks. Along the way, you’ll experience the contrast that defines the city, vibrant entertainment areas, quiet side streets, and unique cultural moments around every corner.

Explore highlights like the famous Shinjuku Cat Billboard, the electric streets of Kabukicho, the narrow bar alleys of Golden Gai, and the world-renowned Shibuya Scramble Crossing. The journey continues through lively shopping streets, rooftop spaces, historic stations, and Tokyo’s iconic nightlife districts.

title: 4K Tokyo Walking Tour | Nippori Yanaka Kitasenju (221 Mins)
description:
This 221-minute Nippori to Kitasenju walking tour explores Tokyo's historic Shitamachi (old downtown) neighborhoods. Walk through traditional shopping streets, historic temples and shrines, cross the Sumida River at Senjuohashi Bridge, and experience the authentic local character of Nippori, Yanaka, and Kitasenju—neighborhoods preserving traditional Tokyo.
NIPPORI TO KITASENJU: HISTORIC SHITAMACHI ROUTE
The walking tour follows a complete route through Tokyo's most historic residential and commercial neighborhoods. Shitamachi refers to the traditional "low city" districts—areas that preserve old Tokyo character while functioning as living neighborhoods where residents live and shop daily.
NIPPORI AND YANAKA NEIGHBORHOODS
The walk begins at Nippori Station and moves through Yanaka—neighborhoods known for preserving traditional Tokyo atmosphere. Historic wooden buildings, narrow streets, and local character define these areas.
Yanaka Ginza is a famous retro shopping street representing the traditional shopping arcade (shotengai) format. Walking through shows how these streets serve local community with small shops and restaurants.
TEMPLES AND SHRINES
The route includes multiple temples and shrines:

Hayato Inari Shrine (historic local shrine)
Zen gardens and memorial parks
Traditional shrine architecture throughout

These spiritual sites show how Tokyo maintains religious and cultural institutions in residential neighborhoods.
NIPPORI FABRIC DISTRICT
The Nippori Fabric District represents local commerce and craft tradition—a neighborhood business hub serving textile traders and local craftspeople.
NIKKO KAIDO: HISTORIC EDO HIGHWAY
The Nikko Kaido is a historic road dating to the Edo period—one of the famous routes connecting Tokyo to other regions. Walking along this historic highway shows the layered history of Tokyo's street structure.
SENJUOHASHI BRIDGE AND SUMIDA RIVER
The Senjuohashi Bridge crosses the Sumida River—a historic crossing point celebrated in Japanese art history. The bridge and river area show Tokyo's geographic and historical relationship with water.
KITASENJU AND LOCAL CULTURE
Kitasenju represents a historic post-town (shukuba) on the Nikko Kaido. The neighborhood maintains local commercial character with shopping arcades (shotengai) and traditional streets.
Senju Sun Road is a vibrant local shopping arcade representing the traditional shopping street format where residents shop daily.
AUTHENTIC SHITAMACHI CHARACTER
Walking through these neighborhoods shows authentic Tokyo—not tourist destinations, but areas where residents live, work, and maintain traditions. The contrast between old wooden buildings and modern development, between quiet temple grounds and bustling shopping streets, defines Shitamachi character.
221-MINUTE CONTINUOUS NEIGHBORHOOD EXPLORATION
This extended 221-minute walk allows complete exploration of multiple historic neighborhoods while maintaining continuous movement. The length shows how traditional Tokyo neighborhoods connect and relate to each other—the transitions, the street patterns, and the scale of historic districts.

title: Heavy Rain Walk in Tokyo’s Record-Breaking Storm: 4K/HDR Video | Relaxing Natural City Ambience
description:
Hello. Thank you for watching my YouTube channel. Experience the calming rain sounds and Tokyo Walks in 4K/60fps/HDR video with immersive binaural audio.
In this video, we took a walk from the area near Shin-Mikawashima Station, passed through Tabata Station, and ended at Nippori Station. The highlight of this video is not the places we visited, but the experience of walking through record-breaking rainfall. We were completely drenched, offering a unique and immersive experience of Tokyo’s rainy atmosphere. Use these rain sounds and city ambiance to help you sleep, study, meditate, and relax.
Thank you.
Don’t forget to like, comment, and subscribe to our channel to enjoy exploring Tokyo even more!

Recorded on: July 31st, around 7 PM
Tokyo’s Kita Ward experienced an estimated 100mm of rain in just an hour. The Japan Meteorological Agency issued multiple “Record Short-Term Heavy Rain Information” alerts, a first in Tokyo’s 23 wards in six years.

What is “Record Short-Term Heavy Rain Information”?
Issued by meteorological offices for rainstorms expected only once in several years, these alerts vary by region and indicate rare and potentially hazardous rainfall.

title: 4K Japan Walking Tour: Cherry blossom season in Tokyo
description:
This 210-minute Tokyo cherry blossom walking tour covers the world-famous Sakura Tunnel at Nihonbashi and the prestigious streets of Ginza during peak cherry blossom season. Walk from historic Kanda through over 150 cherry trees on Edo Sakura Street, explore ancient shrines, and experience the blend of traditional Tokyo and modern luxury during spring's most vibrant season.
CHERRY BLOSSOM SEASON IN TOKYO
This walking tour captures Tokyo's cherry blossoms at their absolute peak—a brief seasonal window when the city transforms. The tour combines natural beauty (cherry trees, blooming flowers) with urban architecture and historic spiritual sites.
NIHONBASHI SAKURA TUNNEL: EDO SAKURA STREET
The Sakura Tunnel features over 150 cherry trees lining Edo Sakura Street at Nihonbashi—one of Tokyo's most stunning seasonal displays. Walking beneath the canopy shows the scale and beauty of this concentrated cherry blossom area.
The tunnel demonstrates how Tokyo creates seasonal focal points by concentrating natural elements in urban spaces.
KANDA: HISTORIC TOKYO BACKSTREETS
The walk begins in Kanda's nostalgic backstreets—areas preserving traditional Tokyo character. Walking through shows historic architecture, narrow lanes, and the older layers of Tokyo existing beneath modern development.
GINZA: LUXURY AND ARCHITECTURE
The route continues to Ginza, Tokyo's most famous district. Walking through Ginza during cherry blossom season shows the contrast between high-end retail, modern architecture, and delicate spring blooms.
HISTORIC SHRINES AND SPIRITUAL SITES
The walk includes several ancient shrines:

Shirohata Inari Shrine
Fukutoku Shrine (ancient sanctuary)
Karasumori Shrine (final destination)

These shrines show how Tokyo maintains spiritual sites throughout the commercial district.
LANDMARKS AND ARCHITECTURE
The tour covers:

Nihonbashi Bridge (historic landmark)
Coredo Muromachi (modern commercial complex)
Ginza Lion (architectural landmark)
Shimbashi transit hub
Various historic and modern buildings

SEASONAL EXPERIENCE: CHERRY BLOSSOM SEASON
This 210-minute tour captures a specific moment—peak cherry blossom season—when Tokyo's appearance changes dramatically. The cherry blossoms create atmosphere, attract crowds, and transform how neighborhoods feel.
Understanding Tokyo during cherry blossom season means understanding how seasonality shapes urban experience and tourism in Japan.

title: CHAMPS-ÉLYSÉES, Paris 🇫🇷 The Most Beautiful Avenue in the World | Walking Tour | 4K 60FPS
description:
CHAMPS-ÉLYSÉES, Paris 🇫🇷 Walking down the most beautiful avenue in the world, from the Arc de Triomphe all the way to the Place de la Concorde, through the heart of Paris and its golden triangle of luxury. Filmed in stunning 4K Ultra HD 60FPS.

Today I'm taking you with me on a walk through one of my favourite parts of Paris, the elegant 8th arrondissement. We start at the Arc de Triomphe, head down the legendary Champs-Élysées, and wander through the golden triangle of haute couture along Avenue Montaigne and Avenue George V, passing some of the most famous fashion houses, hotels and monuments in the world. We then make our way past the Élysée Palace and the Faubourg Saint-Honoré, before finishing at the magnificent Place de la Concorde. I've added captions along the way to share the history and little details behind everything we pass, so you feel like you're really walking beside me.

🌳 The Champs-Élysées stretches nearly 2 kilometers, from the Arc de Triomphe to the Place de la Concorde.
👑 Its name means "Elysian Fields", a reference to the paradise of Greek mythology.
🏛️ Often called "La Plus Belle Avenue du Monde", the most beautiful avenue in the world.
🛍️ Home to flagship stores like Louis Vuitton, Cartier, Dior, and many more.
🍽️ Famous addresses include Le Fouquet's, Ladurée, and the legendary Plaza Athénée.
🎖️ The Arc de Triomphe stands 50 meters tall, commissioned by Napoleon in 1806.
💎 The golden triangle, between Avenue Montaigne, Avenue George V and the Champs-Élysées, is the epicentre of Parisian haute couture.
🏛️ The Place de la Concorde is the largest square in Paris, home to the 3,300-year-old Luxor Obelisk.

title: They’re Not Angry. It’s Just Manhattan Before 9AM | NYC 4K Walk
description:
Manhattan before 9AM is fast walkers, office commuters, yellow taxis and a sidewalk rush that can look tougher than it feels. This NYC 4K walking tour follows Eighth Avenue from the Theater District through the Garment District, Penn Station, Hudson Yards and Macy’s Herald Square.

No talk, just walk.

Filmed on November, 2022.
___
Jewel Changi Airport (also known as Jewel or Jewel Changi) is a nature-themed entertainment and retail complex surrounded by and linked to Changi Airport, Singapore, linked to one of its passenger terminals. Its centrepiece is the world's tallest indoor waterfall, the Rain Vortex, that is surrounded by a terraced forest setting.

Jewel includes gardens, attractions, a hotel, about 300 retail and dining outlets, as well as early baggage check-in aviation facilities. It covers a total gross floor area of 135,700 m2, spanning 10 storeys – five above-ground and five basement levels. Its attractions include the Shiseido Forest Valley, an indoor garden spanning five storeys, and the Canopy Park at the topmost level, featuring gardens and leisure facilities.

Jewel receives about 300,000 visitors per day. In October 2019, six months after its soft opening, it had welcomed 50 million visitors, exceeding its initial target for the whole year. The complex and airport is located in Changi, at the eastern end of Singapore, approximately 20 km (12 mi) northeast from Singapore's Downtown Core.

title: Beijing Daxing International Airport, China's $17 Billion Mega Airport | 4K HDR
description:
Hey, guys, let's walk in the Beijing Daxing International Airport AGAIN!

Beijing Daxing International Airport, also known as Beijing New Airport, is the biggest airport in the world.

It is also the second international airport of Beijing along with Beijing Capital International airport.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
★★★★★ How big is Daxing airport?

The gigantic Daxing airport, with the impressive shape which has given it the nickname “Starfish”, has enormous dimensions.

There are currently 4 runways (with the prospect of becoming 7 in the future) and a vast terminal building covering a 700.000m2 area while the ground transportation center extends to 80.000m2.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
★★★★★ How much did Daxing airport cost?

The construction of the mega-airport, which is expected to eventually become the busiest airport in the world, cost an unsurprisingly large amount.

The Chinese government is estimated to have paid approximately US $17.47 billion for this colossal project.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
★★★★★ How many runways does Daxing airport have?

For the time being, Daxing Airport has four runways and 79 airport stands.

The 4 runways' size is impressive while the airport stands are suitable both for one twin-aisle and two single-aisle planes.

Eventually, the airport will have 7 runways in total and will be able to serve about 620.000 flights annually.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
★★★★★ Which airlines are going to operate at Daxing airport?

Since the airport has recently opened, the number of daily flights is still limited.

The more time that goes by, there will be an increase in air itineraries in the airport’s schedule.

For the time being, all the major China air carriers such as China Eastern, China Southern, China United and Air China airlines are present at Daxing airport along with some international airways.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
★★★★★ Is Beijing Daxing airport the biggest in the world?

A lot of discussions have been going on about which airport is expected to be the biggest in the world.

Beijing Daxing airport and Istanbul new airport (the two most recent and biggest airport projects) “claim” this title.

Beijing Daxing airport has, in fact, the biggest, single terminal building while Istanbul International airport, in its final phase, is expected to be the biggest airport globally in terms of passenger traffic.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
★★★★★ Who designed Daxing airport?

Daxing airport's terminal building is the impressive outcome of the collaboration between ADP Ingeniérie (ADPI) and the architecture team of Zaha Hadid (ZHA) who tragically passed away in 2016.

Subsequently, in August 2018, Hong Kong design studio Lead 8 undertook the design of the new commercial terminal which is anticipated to respond to every passenger’s needs.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
★★★★★ Who owns Beijing Daxing airport?

The colossal project of the Daxing airport construction was funded by the Chinese government.

With its budget reaching 11.5 billion U.S. dollars (80 billion yuan), the second Beijing airport is one of the biggest airports in the world, ultimately serving a 100 million passengers annually!
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

title: Walking Tour at Cebu's World Class Airport - Mactan-Cebu International Airport | 4K | Philippines
description:
Having a world class airport in the Philippines is now possible thanks to Mactan-Cebu International Airport!
___
Mactan Airport Defeats The World’s Best Airport In International Architecture Awards.

The Mactan-Cebu International Airport’s new Terminal 2 wins another international award, this time besting Singapore’s Jewel Changi

The Mactan Cebu International Airport (MCIA) Terminal 2 has been a source of pride for the Filipinos ever since it was inaugurated in June 2018. It has since received global praise and attention, thanks to its ingenious and sleek design that showcases the strength and beauty of local talent and materials.

Last February, MCIA again claimed fame when it defeated Singapore’s Jewel Changi, touted as the “best airport in the world,” at the World Architecture Festival 2019. MCIA Terminal 2 won the “Completed Buildings-Transport” category, besting Singapore’s Jewel Changi Airport; Hong Kong’s West Kowloon Station, among others.

According to the notes by the award-giving body, they chose to give the victory to Mactan Airport because it was a “simple and elegant new airport that uses many locally sourced materials. It is integrated into the local area through the development of a local hub and a landscape plan. The internal spaces are light and uncluttered... It is clearly popular with the local community and this established a memorable travels experiences.”

In a report by ABS-CBN News, Winston Shu, principal architect of the International Design Associates (IDA), said that unlike the Jewel that required a $1.25-billion price tag, the judges commended Mactan Airport for its “economy in manufacturing,” which means it can be achieved with fewer resources compared to others. They also called the airport “very confident, yet very modest.”

Today, we'll take a thorough look at Singapore Changi Airport, famous as one of the world's best airports.

We'll explore each floor of the Jewel complex, see the indoor waterfall Rain Vortex, and spend the night at a hotel within Jewel. Furthermore, we'll check out the departure halls and restricted areas (transit areas) of each terminal.

Singapore is home to one of the world's busiest and most renowned airports: Singapore Changi Airport (IATA code: SIN).

 Singapore Changi Airport is located in the eastern part of Singapore, about 20 kilometers (12 miles) from the city center. It is easily accessible by various forms of transportation, including taxis, buses, and the Mass Rapid Transit (MRT) system.

Changi Airport consists of several terminals, with Terminal 1, Terminal 2, Terminal 3, and Terminal 4. Each terminal offers a wide range of services and facilities, including shopping, dining, and entertainment options.

There are plans to build a fifth terminal, known as Terminal 5, to accommodate the growing demand for air travel in the region. This expansion is expected to further solidify Changi Airport's position as a major international hub.

 Changi Airport is renowned for its extensive array of amenities and services. These include gardens, movie theaters, snooze lounges, children's play areas, a butterfly garden, and even a rooftop swimming pool. The airport also offers an extensive range of dining and shopping options.

 The airport features a network of automated people movers, including skytrains and travelators, to make it easy for passengers to move between terminals and gates.

 Changi Airport is known for its efficient immigration and security processes. This helps ensure that passengers experience minimal delays when passing through these checkpoints.

 The airport is home to various art installations and sculptures, contributing to its reputation as a visually appealing and culturally rich airport.

 For travelers with long layovers, Changi Airport offers transit hotels where you can rest and refresh during your journey.

 Changi Airport offers free city tours for passengers with long layovers, allowing them to explore some of Singapore's iconic sights.

 The airport is famous for its duty-free shopping, and you can find a wide range of products, from electronics to fashion and luxury goods.

 You can easily reach the city center by taxi, shuttle, or the MRT system from the airport.

Singapore Changi Airport consistently ranks as one of the best airports in the world due to its exceptional facilities, services, and customer satisfaction. It serves as a major international gateway and transit hub, connecting passengers to various destinations worldwide.

Welcome to the Singapore Changi Airport, consistently voted the World's Best Airport. If you think you know layovers, think again. We're taking you on a FULL TOUR inside the legendary Jewel Changi complex, an absolute architectural masterpiece.

From the moment we step off the plane, you won't believe the attractions: the world's tallest Indoor Waterfall (Rain Vortex) 💧, a massive indoor forest (Shiseido Forest Valley), bouncing nets, and hidden gardens. We reveal all the amazing (and often FREE) things you can do on a layover, why this airport is a destination in itself, and where to find the best food and quiet spots.

Planning a Singapore trip or an upcoming Changi Airport layover in 2025? This is the ultimate full tour and guide to the World's Best Airport!

Join us as we go INSIDE the $1.7 BILLION architectural wonder that is Jewel Changi. This video covers everything you need to know:

The Rain Vortex: Getting the best view of the world's tallest indoor waterfall.

Changi's Secrets: Hidden attractions, gardens (like the Butterfly Garden), and entertainment across the terminals.

Layover Hacks: How to use your time efficiently and find the free amenities (cinema, sleeping areas, etc.).

Food: Our review of the best dining at Jewel and the terminals.

Don't just survive your layover—enjoy it! We show you how the Singapore Changi experience redefines air travel.

title: Dubai Airport (DXB) Terminal 3 Walking Tour 4K🇦🇪
description:
Dubai Airport (DXB) Terminal 3 Walking Tour 4K🇦🇪

Dubai Airport Terminal 3 (DXB) is the world's largest terminal by area, and it is the main hub of Emirates Airline. In fact, it is not a single building, but a whole complex consisting of several halls.
--------------------------------
Here is a detailed description:
General information
Airlines: Terminal 3 is used exclusively by Emirates Airline (and its subsidiary low-cost airline flydubai, whose flights have the EK code). Emirates SkyCargo cargo carrier is also based here.
Location: Directly adjacent to the west side of Terminal 1 (a common terminal for other airlines). A free train runs between them.
Structure: It consists of three main halls connected to each other
---------------------------------
How to get there/navigate
By metro: Airport Terminal 3 station (the red line of the Dubai Metro) is located on the Arrivals level of the main terminal building. This is a very convenient way to get from the city.
By taxi: There is a special taxi stand at the arrival level.
By car: Multi-level parking (Terminal 3 Car Park) is connected to the main terminal building by a covered pedestrian bridge.

title: Cyprus 4K - Walking Tour - Nissi Beach, Konnos Beach, Ayia Napa, Sea Caves
description:
Visit the spectacularly beautiful beaches of Cyprus in this 4K walking tour. The sea and sand near Ayia Napa in the southeast of Cyprus are gorgeous. Enjoy the scenery and amazing views in this travel video recorded in May 2023!

We start with popular Nissi Beach and its white sand and clear blue water. Next, are the Sea Caves and beautiful cliffs just a few kilometers east of Ayia Napa. The sea coves nearby offer an incredible place to view the water and the vibrant blue colors. Next, we visit Konnos Beach which is an amazing location where the sandy beach meets the Mediterranean. A couple of kilometers to the north is the town of Protaras and the calm water of Fig Tree beach with a small island just off shore. The tour concludes with a visit to the longest walking beach in the area called Limanaki Beach and Glyki Nero Beach just next to the resorts and hotels in Ayia Napa.

Locations Visited on the Tour:
0:00 Video Preview
0:55 Start of Walk at Nissi Beach
8:51 Aya Napa Island
32:48 Sea Caves
38:22 Blue Lagoon of Cabo Greco
46:41 Konnos Beach
58:26 Fig Tree Beach

Ayia Napa (Αγία Νάπα) is a Mediterranean resort town on the southeast coast of Cyprus, known for its beaches. The town's main landmark is the storied, Venetian-era Ayia Napa Monastery, which stands in the central square of Plateia Seferi, surrounded by bars and clubs. Freshly caught seafood is served at Ayia Napa Harbour’s busy tavernas, while adjoining Pantachou Beach offers a stretch of golden sand.

Nissi Beach (Παραλία Νησί): This idyllic stretch of sand beach has earned a blue flag designation for its clean, aqua waters. - Google

Aya Napa Island: Rugged, scrub vegetation-covered island linked to Nissi Beach by a stretch of shallow, clear water.

Sea Caves: Dramatic coastal area with rugged bluffs & sea caves, popular with divers and cliff jumpers. - Google

Konnos Beach (Κόννος): Sandy beach with clear, shallow water for swimming & water sports, plus chair rentals. - Google

Fig Tree (Παραλία της Συκιάς): Small sand beach featuring rental loungers & umbrellas, water sports & clear, calm waters.

Glyki Nero Beach (Γλυκύ Νερό): Sandy spot known for its clear waters, with rows of umbrella-shaded sun loungers & nearby sea caves. - Google

Welcome to our 4K walking tour through Naha, Okinawa, Japan!

Immerse yourself in the beautiful summer vibes of this enchanting island city. As we stroll through the streets of Naha, you'll be captivated by the unique blend of traditional Japanese street design and the tropical island atmosphere.

Feel the warmth of the sun as we walk under the shade of swaying palm trees. Notice the vibrant Japanese signage and charming street lamps that line the avenues, adding a distinctive touch to the urban landscape. The streets are adorned with cute pastel colours, giving the city a cheerful and welcoming feel.

Join us as we explore the lively markets, bustling shopping streets, and serene parks of Naha. Discover the local culture, indulge in delicious street food, and enjoy the relaxed island pace that makes Okinawa so special. This tour offers a perfect blend of natural beauty and cultural richness, all captured in breathtaking 4K HDR.

Don’t miss out on this delightful journey through Naha, Okinawa! Like, comment, and subscribe for more immersive walking tours and travel adventures.

title: Saturday Night in Paris...But Something Feels Different | Le Marais to Notre-Dame | 4K Paris Walk
description:
Experience the magic of a summer Saturday night in mid-June! In this 4K POV 60fps city walk, we explore the vibrant Paris nightlife, starting from the historic Le Marais district and winding our way toward the majestic Notre-Dame Cathedral. Feel the energy of the Latin Quarter, pass by iconic cafes and bars, and enjoy the breathtaking Seine river night views as river cruise boats (Bateaux-Mouches) glide past. We’ll uncover hidden gems like the quiet Rue du Trésor and find the perfect angles of Notre-Dame from Rue Saint-Julien le Pauvre. This is the ultimate Paris night walk through the glowing city streets.

title: [4K] MEXICO CITY 2026 🇲🇽 1 Hour Aerial Drone Relaxation Film UHD | Ciudad de México CDMX
description:
Mexico City (Ciudad de México 2026 in Spanish, aerial an drone filming filming) is the biggest city and the capital of Mexico. It is also the oldest city of the Americas. Mexico City was first built by the indigenous Aztec people and previously known as Tenochtitlan. Tenochtitlan was originally constructed on a island in a lake. After the Spanish conquest of Mexico by Hernán Cortés in 1519, Lake Tenochtitlan was drained. The Spanish built Catholic Churches over the Aztec temples. Most famous example is the Catedral Metropolitana de la Ciudad de México in downtown Mexico City. Nowadays Mexico City metropolitan area has a population of 22 million and is one of the biggest and fast growing cities in the world. 40 kilometers north of Mexico City is the ancient city of Teotihuacan located from the first millennium (1 AD to 500 AD). Teotihuacan was the largest city in the pre-Columbian Americas, with a population estimated at least 125,000.

Lebanon 2026 4K Drone, 1 Hour Scenic and Soothing Relaxation Aerial Drone Film and Video in 4K and 8K for stress relief of Lebanon (لُبْنَان 2026) with Beirut (بيروت 2026), Batroun, Baalbek, Sannine Mountain, Sayidat Al Qarn, Aaqoura ; piano music, classical music, ambient music, meditation, yoga, zen, calming music, working music, study music, nature, relaxing.

Lebanon (or لُبْنَان in Arabic 2026) is a country in the Middle East and part of the Levant. Lebanon like Syria was strongly Hellenized during the ancient and Byzantine medieval times (Greek Orthodox). After the conquest of the Arabs the country became partly Islamized but it still has a strong Christian presence. Mount Lebanon Mutasarrifate saw the emergence of the monastic orthodox traditions of the Maronites, and later of the Druze. This led to the Maronite-Druz dualism of Lebanon which is still present today. Lebanon is famous for its Cedar trees which are known as the Cedars of God. The cedar is the symbol of Lebanon and also represented in the Lebanese Flag. Lebanon is a country of 6 million people. Many of the Lebanese live in Beirut. The metropolitan area of Beirut has a population of 2,2 million.

On 4 August 2020, a massive explosion in the Port of Beirut resulted in the death of hundreds of people and destroyed the harbour and a huge part of the city. As many as 300,000 people have been left homeless by the explosion. The explosion was followed up by a huge fire in the city in September 2020. The cause of the blast is believed to be from stored ammonium nitrate. However, Beirut is rising from its ashes.

Music By Matteo de Grandis, Thomas Enger and Sarah Watson.

Young leaves are sprouting from the trees at the foot of the mountain, and the temperature in the city exceeds 30 degrees, but there is still a lot of snow on Mt. Fuji.

Mt.Fuji is 100km from the city center and takes about 2 hours.
Climbing takes a bus to the 5th Station (under the snow) and takes about 6 hours to reach the summit.
There is no snow in July and August, so you can enjoy it without worry.

There are five lakes on the north side (Yamanashi Prefecture, mountain side), and tourism is popular.
Dairy farming is thriving on the south side (sea side of Shizuoka Prefecture), and there are many grasslands and auto-camping grounds, and music festivals are also held.

title: POV: Driving the Most Beautiful Roads in the Atlantic 🌊 [4K]
description:
Take a drive through some of the most dramatic landscapes in the Atlantic. 🌊 This route starts in the quiet, terraced valley of Boaventura, winding through narrow village backroads and passing the historic Solar de Boaventura before the scenery completely shifts.

Experience the thrill of Madeira's famous coastal roads, from rockfall-prone cliffside passes to the Duarte Pacheco tunnel. As we climb into the Queimadas laurel forest, the rain brings out the scent of eucalyptus before we head back down to Ponta Delgada to catch the sunset at Fajã da Areia. 🌅✨

If you enjoy long-form driving tours with real engine and road sounds, consider subscribing for more 4K runs around the island! 🔔

title: POV Truck Driving USA | 11-Hour Journey from Ohio to Wyoming | Relaxing 4K Long-Haul Road Trip
description:
POV Truck Driving USA — a full 11-hour long-haul journey across Ohio, Nebraska, and Wyoming, captured in immersive 4K.
From morning highways to mountain horizons, this drive reveals the beauty of America’s heartland — endless roads, open skies, and the calm rhythm of the Volvo VNL 760 engine.

This cinematic drive is designed for relaxation, sleep, focus, or virtual trucking fans who love the feeling of being on the road.
Perfect for viewers from India, Brazil, Germany, Indonesia, Poland, Italy, Turkey, and the USA — who enjoy realistic trucking, long-distance drives, and atmospheric 4K road footage.

Sit back, relax, and experience the full American journey — from flat Midwest plains to the wild Wyoming landscapes.

description:
This is episode 4 of my 2022 STREET FOOD IN TURKEY series! This time I'm in Istanbul again and taking you for some seriously delicious desserts. Turkish desserts are world renowned and today we are tasting all my favorites from KÜNEFE to BAKLAVA!! To end the day let's cruise the Bosphorus and explore the sights of beautiful Istanbul!

Try the Turkish food in this video yourself @ https://www.buyinturkey.com

title: Weird STREET FOOD tour in Istanbul as vegetarians. Turkey 2021
description:
Are you ready for this weird street food tour as vegetarians, here in Istanbul?
After 6 months in Greece without being able to try any local food because of the lockdown, we had to do a video in Istanbul about trying as much things as we could while we are here. But we wanted to make it a bit more exciting by trying to find all the weird street food things that we could it in Istanbul Turkey in 2021 🤩
Street food is really popular in Turkey and it’s really easy to find different choices everywhere in Istanbul 👍🏼
As vegetarians it’s wasn’t that easy to find weird food because most of the typical dishes here are with meat, but we found it with the help of some locals who recommended us yo typical turkish neighbourhoods and places 🤗

title: Turkey Eminönü to Sirkeci Istanbul Walking Tour 4K HDR | Ramadan Bazaar & Street Food
description:
Step into the vibrant heart of historic Istanbul on this immersive Istanbul Walking Tour from Eminönü Bazaar to Sirkeci, filmed during the peaceful hours before iftar in Ramadan.

This 50-minute real-time walking tour captures the authentic atmosphere of real Istanbul life, where locals and visitors gather among historic markets, street food stalls, traditional cafes, and lively bazaar streets. The walk begins in Eminönü, one of the oldest commercial centers of Istanbul, famous for its bazaars, spice shops, and street food culture. From there we continue through the bustling streets toward Sirkeci, a historic district once known as the gateway to Europe via the legendary Orient Express railway.

During Ramadan evenings, the energy of the city becomes even more special. Vendors prepare food, restaurants set tables for iftar, and the streets fill with people enjoying the warm atmosphere of Istanbul before sunset.

Filmed in March 2026 on a clear sunny day with a temperature of 10°C, this tour was recorded in 4K HDR at 60fps with binaural audio, allowing you to experience the real sounds of Istanbul — footsteps, conversations, street vendors, and the unique rhythm of daily life.

This channel, formerly known as Mitamo Journeys, continues its mission as MJ Walking Tours, documenting authentic city life across Istanbul and Turkey through cinematic real-time POV walking tours.

If you enjoy exploring cities through authentic walking tours, please support the channel:

👍 Like the video
💬 Share your favorite moment
🔔 Subscribe for more Istanbul walking tours and Turkey walking tour 4K experiences

Also check out our sister channel MJ City Ambience, where we observe city life from static cinematic viewpoints.

Welcome to Turkey (Türkiye) and for the next 11 Days I’m taking you on an ultimate Turkish street food tour all the way from Istanbul to Gaziantep. We’ll eat some of the most famous, unique, and interesting foods in Turkey!

Our journey begins in Istanbul where we’ll discover some of the most classic Turkish street foods that local people eat. We’ll then travel to Izmir on the Aegean coast for seafood and some unique culinary specialties. From Izmir we’ll continue to Gaziantep, known to be the food capital of Turkey, where we’ll try eggplant kebab, and one of the world’s best baklava. From Gaziantep we’ll go to Adana to try the most famous kebab in Turkey! And finally to wrap up this tour we’ll return to Istanbul for more delicious Turkish food.

This Turkey food documentary not only includes all 49 meals I ate during our trip, but also a lot of behind the scenes and extras scenes from our trip.

I spent the day walking through the Old Town, starting from the Royal Mile all the way up to the Castle. The atmosphere here is incredible—it really feels like stepping back in time.

Vienna Walking Tour 2025 Old Town of Vienna Walk and Attractions 4K
The Old Town of Vienna, known as Innere Stadt, is the historic heart of the city, characterized by its rich architectural ensembles, including Baroque buildings, grand streets like Ringstrasse, and cobbled alleyways.
 Discover the heart of Vienna with this stunning tour through its most iconic sights: stroll down Graben Street and Kärntner Straße, admire the Column of Pest, and marvel at St. Stephen’s Cathedral. Visit the Sisi Museum, historic St. Michael’s Church, and the luxurious Kohlmarkt street. Indulge in world-famous sweets at Demel and the elegant Café Central. Explore the beauty of Volksgarten and Stadtpark, all nestled in The Innere Stadt. This Vienna travel guide showcases top attractions and hidden gems—perfect for tourists seeking history, culture, and the best things to do in Vienna.

title: LEIPZIG, Germany 🇩🇪 4K Walking Tour | Old Town, Shopping Streets & Summer City Life
description:
🖼️ Prints of my travel photos (EU/UK)*: https://juniqe.com/p/cbqwrlpm
🌍 Prints of my travel photos (worldwide)*: https://www.goodmoodprints.com/artists/boldandretro?artist=HXSBQue3HfM9M11Y5UgV

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

What does Leipzig feel like on a hot summer Saturday? Join this full-length 4K walking tour through the heart of Leipzig, Germany, filmed in bright sunshine at around 29°C / 84°F. 🇩🇪☀️

The 1 hour 43 minute walk begins at Augustusplatz and explores Leipzig’s lively city center at street level. We follow busy shopping streets, enter historic arcades and modern malls, pass packed restaurant terraces and discover landmarks including Leipzig Opera, the City-Hochhaus, Specks Hof, the Old Stock Exchange, Mädler Passage, Market Square, the Old Town Hall and St. Thomas Church.

The route continues through Petersstraße, Messehof Passage, Reichsstraße and Höfe am Brühl before ending at Willy-Brandt-Platz with a view of Leipzig Central Station. This is not an empty-city walk: it captures the authentic atmosphere of a popular German city on a sunny August weekend.

Watch it as virtual travel, use it to plan a Leipzig city trip or enjoy more than 100 minutes of real urban ambience on a big TV, computer or phone.

🎧 No narration and no added music – only authentic street sounds, conversations, shops, restaurants and city ambience recorded during the walk.

💬 Which part of Leipzig would you explore first: the historic passages, St. Thomas Church or the busy shopping streets?

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

📍 WALK INFORMATION

📍 Location: Leipzig, Saxony, Germany
🚶 Route: Augustusplatz → Old Town → shopping streets and passages → Central Station
☀️ Weather: Sunny Saturday in August, around 29°C / 84°F
🎧 Audio: Real ambient sounds, no narration or added music

📍 ABOUT LEIPZIG CITY CENTER

Leipzig’s compact center combines historic trade courtyards, elegant passages, shopping streets, restaurants and major music landmarks. The 140-meter Mädler Passage was built from 1912 to 1914. Johann Sebastian Bach worked at St. Thomas Church from 1723 to 1750, while Leipzig Central Station forms a monumental gateway to the city center.

title: A Rainforest Walk to Black Hole Falls - No Talk, No Music, Just Nature. - 4K Virtual Hike
description:
A virtual Rainforest walk & hike on the North Fork Siouxon Trail to Black Hole Falls, with no talk, no music, no close-up shots of my ugly mug... just nature & relaxation. The full journey in real-time, 4K video.

Nestled in the South Cascades of Washington - not far from the Portland metro area, but a world away - the pristine rainforest and crystalline water of North Siouxon Creek hides in a rugged canyon, one of the few remaining drainages in the area not scarred by roads and clearcuts. Unlike more popular (but also gorgeous) Siouxon Creek, its cousin to the north is quieter and more of a local secret, partly due to the distances involved & at times sketchy road access and trail.

Aside from the lush Pacific Northwest flora, this trail also crosses numerous tumbling side creeks and a few chances to visit North Siouxon Creek itself before climbing to stunning Black Hole Falls. On the way you may spot woodland flowers & glimpses of wildlife, with only the sound of birdsong, wind-rustled trees, and lots of rushing water to keep you company. Enjoy!

title: Redwood Forest Soundscape | 4K Forest Walk, Not AI | Natural Ambience | Study & Meditation
description:
Not AI generated content, all images and sounds are original content and property of Listening To Earth
The sound of morning among the giants. This soundscape was recorded in Redwood National Park August 17, 2021. Behind the scenes notes: This was probably the most difficult sound recording I have ever gone after. A redwood forest is naturally very quiet. During the majority of the day, you only hear wind through the needles of redwood trees and the occasional chirping of birds. The dawn chorus is the most active sonic time of the day in most environments, but certainly so in a Redwood Forest.
Due to it’s natural silence, it is very difficult to escape the sound of traffic noise from U.S. 101. Even several miles away from it, my microphone was able to pick up the distant low-end rumble of semi-tractor-trailers roaring down the highway. It took me several days to find a decent recording location that was a balance between eliminating traffic noise and finding interesting sound sources. Additionally, many of the sound sources—birds—are perched in the canopy of the tallest trees in the world. This introduces an added layer of difficulty to recording. In best recording practices, a sound source should be close to the microphone element. This prevents overcompensation by cranking the gain and raising the noise floor (the white noise kind of sound).
These two major hurdles influenced my decision on where to record. On the last day, I chose an area several miles away from U.S. 101 that had a hardwood hammock growing where the redwood canopy had opened up to allow more light. The lower branches of the hardwood trees brought the songbirds closer to my microphone while the ravens stayed higher in the redwoods. The ravens being further away created an eerie echo that sonically painted an image of the space towering trees create. This recording is just after sunrise as a heavy mist accumulated on the trees then dripped down to the ferns below.

Recorded in stereo - headphones will immerse you in this natural soundscape and enhance your experience. Use this sound as a background ambience for studying, working, creative inspiration, meditation, restorative exercises, or relaxation.

title: Impossible Places: World's Most Extreme Corners on Earth | 4K Travel Documentary
description:
Impossible Places: World's Most Extreme Corners on Earth | 4K Travel Documentary

Across deserts of fire, frozen frontiers, and remote islands untouched by time lie the most extreme corners of our planet — places where nature pushes the limits of survival and beauty. From boiling volcanic lakes to towering cliffs rising above the clouds, these landscapes remind us how wild and powerful Earth truly is.

In this episode of New Travel Insight, we journey through the world’s most extreme and impossible places, exploring environments that challenge human imagination and reveal nature at its rawest. Each destination shows a different face of our planet — harsh, mysterious, and breathtaking beyond belief.

Like, comment, and share if you believe the most extraordinary wonders are found in the world’s most extreme places.

title: TASMANIA: Australia's Lost World | 4K Travel Documentary
description:
Discover the most beautiful places in Tasmania — the wildest island in Australia, hanging off the edge of the continent where the map runs out and the Southern Ocean begins, where towering dolerite cliffs drop three hundred metres into churning seas, where rainforests breathe that have survived since the age of the dinosaurs, where the air is the cleanest ever measured on Earth, and where hidden valleys shelter living things tens of thousands of years old. This 4K travel documentary journeys across the full breadth of the island, through alpine wilderness carved by ice ages, along coastlines shaped by the most powerful ocean on the planet, and deep into a landscape so ancient and so untouched it feels like the rest of the world simply never found it. Australia's most extraordinary island. At the bottom of the map.

🔔 Hi, I'm Hendrik from VoyagersTV. Join us on immersive journeys to the world’s most remarkable places. Subscribe to embark the voyage! 👉 https://www.youtube.com/@voyagers.travel

Planning your next trip to Tasmania? These are the exact tools I personally use to save money on flights, hotels, and activities — and to stay comfortable while exploring the world.
